title: The_Calixis_Sector
rewritten:
[The Calixis Sector — Sector]
Location: Segmentum Obscurus, northern galactic edge.
Founded: Conquered by Lord Militant Golgenna Angevin ~1000 years ago.
First governor: Drusus (later Imperial saint).
Capital: Scintilla, in the Golgenna Reach.
Neighbours: Ixaniad Sector (coreward), Halo Stars (rimward, contested).
Threat: Hereticus Tenebrae aka the Tyrant Star — prophesied doom Inquisition seeks to destroy.
Government: Sector Governor Marius Hax officially rules from Lucid Palace, Scintilla. Calixian Conclave (Lord Inquisitor Caidin) is true power.

title: Sector_Governor_Marius_Hax
rewritten:
[Marius Hax — NPC]
Role: Sector Governor of Calixis. Formal title: Lord Sector / Lord Calixis.
Origin: Ancient Terran noble bloodline (Segmentum Solar).
Appointed: ~150 years ago by High Lords of Terra.
Age: ~200 Scintillan years; juvenat-treated, appears ~50.
Seat: Lucid Palace, Scintilla.
Personality: Solemn, intimidating, obsessive about minutiae of governance. Rare public appearances.

title: The_Lathes
rewritten:
[The Lathes — Forge World System]
Three planetoids in anarchic orbit around a blue-white sun: Lathe-Het, Lathe-Hesh, Lathe-Hadd.
Foremost forge worlds of the Calixis Sector; rival Scintilla's Gunmetal City for arms output.
Famous for: Lathe-blade swords, unbreakable. Hyper-gravity events from intersecting orbits.
Control: Adeptus Mechanicus (Lathe-Covenant). Arch-Magos rules; Mechanicum has converted nearly every object in-system.

title: The_Periphery
rewritten:
[The Periphery — Sub-sector]
Most remote sub-sector of Calixis. Only one not bordering Golgenna Reach (lies spinward).
Neighbours: Malfian Sub-sector, Markayn Marches.
Character: Frontier worlds, marginalized populations, isolated planets.
Clerical authority: Cardinal Fortis, Arch-Diocese of Periphery and Halo Stars; rules from starship Pax Calixis.

title: Random_Pilgrim
display_title: Wandering Pilgrim of the Drusian Creed
rewritten:
[Drusian Pilgrim — Atmosphere]
Wandering pilgrims of Saint Drusus' Creed travel the Calixis Sector.
Wear ash-grey robes, carry a small icon of Drusus' lance.
Often beg passage on Imperial vessels; some claim minor miracles.
Useful as flavour NPCs in any pious or shrine-world scene.
